## Experience
- Startiqos.AI (2025 – 2026), GenAI / Product Builder Intern: agentic workflows in LangGraph and CrewAI for idea validation, market analysis and execution planning; RAG pipelines with FastAPI backends; containerized Docker services integrating REST APIs with PostgreSQL and Supabase.

## Projects
- **Warrant AI:** A zero-trust identity and access-control architecture that verifies delegated authority between autonomous AI agents before they act. Final-year thesis, in progress.
- **LLM Fine-Tuning & Evaluation:** Fine-tuned LLaMA 3 and Mistral with LoRA and QLoRA using Hugging Face Transformers and PEFT, on curated JSONL instruction datasets, compared on held-out evaluation sets.
- **Autonomous Enterprise Operating System:** An AI-native operating system with LangGraph agents and a shared vector-database retrieval layer that automates routine workflows across 8 business functions: HR, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Legal, Operations and IT.
- **Incident Response & Threat Detection Dashboard:** A Power BI dashboard that brings incident and threat data into one place, so a security team can spot threats and respond faster.
- **Multi-Agent Startup Idea Validator:** A RAG system where several AI agents with different points of view debate one startup idea, then return a single balanced verdict. Built at Startiqos.AI.
